_doc: Append an entry for EVERY env- or compile-gated kernel variant. tier1_kernel/test_kernel_variant_equivalence.py auto-discovers this file; schema in common/variant_registry.py. The shipped kernel is the reference: variants gate bit-exact (maxdiff==0) unless a tolerance is explicitly declared and justified.

variants.name: nvfp4_lut256
variants.notes: Shipped-source variant: byte->half2 smem LUT instead of the SM120a cvt.rn.f16x2.e2m1x2 hardware conversion. Values are identical by construction; guards the fp4 decode table.

variants.name: aqlm_cb_l1
variants.notes: Shipped-source variant: __ldca (L1-cached) codebook loads instead of __ldcg. Load-path-only change; exercises the machinery that will gate the L2-residency/__ldcs optimization (idea 5).

variants.name: pcie_custom_allreduce
variants.notes: decode-C: VLLM_PCIE_CUSTOM_AR un-gates vLLM's custom CUDA-IPC P2P allreduce for 4x PCIe-only SM120 (NCCL SHM-bounces on this box). fp-reorder-class: deterministic rank-ordered sum (1stage <512KB / 2stage above) vs NCCL's ring order; the real gate is tier2 test_allreduce_equivalence's exact-fp64 reorder bound + repeat determinism, plus the 64K NLL envelope. Tolerance here covers the tier1 trivial pass (comms variant has no single-GPU content).

variants.name: aqlm_mlp4
variants.notes: Shipped-source variant: codebook gathers batched 4 instead of 8 in flight. Load scheduling only; arithmetic order unchanged, so bit-exactness is REQUIRED (regression tripwire for anyone touching the gather batching).
